kernel_source_review.fact: Direct close removes slot and clears allocation bitmap before completion is observed.
Clearing resets allocator hint to removed slot, so later allocation can immediately reuse it.
Direct close removes under ring lock then returns completion; file_index is one-based.
Direct accept disallows CLOEXEC and independently installs selected fixed descriptor before completion.
